components.name: Key
components.role: The universal typed, validated, append-only event object (id/type/targets/scale_signature/symbolic_dimensions/…). No cascade_depth field.

components.name: Target
components.role: One targets[] entry (actor, role, impact_vector, stat_deltas). Wide fan-out is ONE Key with N targets, never N Keys.

components.name: KeyLog
components.role: The append-only canonical log — enforces all 8 universal invariants, deterministic serialize()/content_hash() for replay.

components.name: TypeRegistry
components.role: Loads/validates against key_type_registry_v30.md at runtime (parses the markdown) instead of duplicating the roster in code.

components.name: TickScheduler
components.role: The engine_clock-shaped emission seam — tick queue, cascade_depth re-entrancy meter, Level-B termination guard, deferred-apply at ACCOUNTING.

components.name: TerminationBreach
components.role: Raised when a Level-B termination invariant is violated — never silently clamped.

propagation.name: Aggregate-up
propagation.desc: faction_stat has no setter: it is AGGREGATE(child stats) ⊕ Σ event-modifiers, a query over KEY_LOG. Domain Echoes defer-apply at the Accounting boundary (OF-7, ratified).

propagation.name: Distribute-down
propagation.desc: A strategic/environmental Key reaching sub-scale actors must populate targets[] + scale_signature[] at emission. Fan-out is one Key, not N.

propagation.name: Termination
propagation.desc: Level A (per-tick fixpoint) and Level B (per-cascade bound) are PROVEN; cross-tick convergence is NOT — it waits on decay() (OF-3) and the D.6 disjointness ruling.

field_extension.desc: A Key is a one-shot emission — wrong for continuous VECTOR state (Legitimacy/PS, Pressure Π, MS, Accord).
